title: The Day the Oceans Came Back

portraits.nora: Photorealistic head-and-shoulders portrait of a Latina woman about 58, sun-weathered skin, grey-streaked black hair in a thick braid, dark brown eyes, navy boat captain's jacket, strong kind face, plain soft grey background, soft window light, 85mm lens.
portraits.mia: Photorealistic head-and-shoulders portrait of a 16-year-old girl, wavy dark-brown hair, light freckles, olive skin, hazel eyes, simple sand-colored linen shirt, curious expression, plain soft grey background, soft window light, 85mm lens.

looks.nora: Nora: Latina woman about 58, sun-weathered skin, grey-streaked black braid, navy captain's jacket, same face as her reference image
looks.mia: Mia: 16-year-old girl, wavy dark-brown hair, light freckles, olive skin, sand-colored linen shirt, same face as her reference image

style: Cinematic photorealistic film still, vertical 9:16 composition with the subject centered, natural documentary color grade, epic scale, present day unless described, no text, no letters, no numbers.

scenes.image: Vertical shot of a small town built on white salt plains on the old seafloor, a giant old cliff behind.
lines: [relaxed, conversational] A hundred years after the oceans vanished, people live on the old seafloor.

scenes.image: Mia in her small bedroom in a town on the dry old seafloor, holding an old photograph of a woman on a tugboat, white salt plains visible through the window, no sea.
lines: Mia is sixteen. She has never seen a wave.
[wistful] Great-grandma said the sea sounded like breathing.

scenes.image: Ordinary townspeople in simple clothes standing in a dusty street of a small town on dry white salt plains at dawn, turning toward a dark line on the horizon.
sfx: A deep rising roar of approaching water

scenes.image: A colossal wall of blue water rising across the salt plains toward a tiny town.
lines: [urgent, hushed] The oceans come back. All at once.
scenes.motion: An enormous wall of water surges across the salt plain toward the tiny town, epic slow motion.

scenes.image: Mia alone on a high ridge above a flooded basin staring at the ocean for the first time.
lines: And for the first time... she hears it.
sfx: Gentle ocean waves on a beach with distant seagulls

scenes.image: Mia seen from behind on a high grassy ridge, wind in her hair, looking out over an endless calm blue ocean at sunrise.
lines: [whispering] It really does sound like breathing.
